units.source_text: 小君因见公子伤心，也不思睡眠，只管往来奔走。

en.t: Seeing how heartbroken the young lord was, Kogimi could not think of sleeping either and simply kept running back and forth on his errands.

units.source_text: 空蝉深恐别人怀疑，甚是担心。

en.t: Utsusemi was deeply afraid that others would become suspicious, and she was extremely worried.
